patterns.name: Array iteration / running state
patterns.cue: Track a running value while scanning; distinguish one transaction from many.

patterns.name: Prefix / suffix products
patterns.cue: Output excludes its own position; combine work before and after it.

patterns.name: Prefix sum / subarray sum
patterns.cue: Repeated ranges or contiguous sums, including negatives; subtract prefix sums.

patterns.name: Hashing: lookup, counting & grouping
patterns.cue: Need membership, complementary values, frequencies or a canonical grouping key.

patterns.name: Two pointers inward
patterns.cue: Ordered or symmetric data permits excluding one end safely.

patterns.name: Same-direction / write pointers
patterns.cue: Preserve a processed prefix while scanning or writing in place.

patterns.name: String traversal / encoding
patterns.cue: Scan characters or frame strings without ambiguous delimiters.

patterns.name: Palindrome expansion
patterns.cue: Contiguous palindrome; odd and even centers both matter.

patterns.name: Sliding Window: fixed size
patterns.cue: Every candidate has exactly k elements; update only entering/leaving values.

patterns.name: Sliding Window: variable size
patterns.cue: A contiguous region has a constraint; define when it must shrink.

patterns.name: Stack: matching & state
patterns.cue: Nested matching or most recent unfinished operation; retain needed state.

patterns.name: Monotonic stack
patterns.cue: Next greater/smaller position; unresolved indices wait for an answer.

patterns.name: Monotonic deque / window maximum
patterns.cue: Window extremes need expiry at the front and dominated-value removal at the back.

patterns.name: Queue / FIFO
patterns.cue: Arrival order, amortized operations or a BFS frontier.

patterns.name: Binary Search: sorted / rotated
patterns.cue: An ordered half can be excluded; state the search interval invariant.

patterns.name: Binary Search: boundaries
patterns.cue: First/last valid index or timestamp; define the boundary predicate.

patterns.name: Binary Search: answer space
patterns.cue: A feasibility predicate changes once as an answer parameter increases.

patterns.name: Linked list pointer manipulation
patterns.cue: Rewire links safely; save the next reference before overwriting.

patterns.name: Fast / slow pointers
patterns.cue: Cycle or midpoint in a repeated successor relation.

patterns.name: Recursion warm-ups
patterns.cue: A smaller subproblem and a terminating base case; use only if needed.

patterns.name: Trees: DFS / recursive reasoning
patterns.cue: Combine subtree results or carry path context through recursive calls.

patterns.name: Trees: BFS levels
patterns.cue: Depth groups or one representative per level; process frontier boundaries.

patterns.name: BST ordering
patterns.cue: Ancestor-wide ordering bounds or sorted inorder traversal.

patterns.name: Heap: top K / ordered streams
patterns.cue: Keep a bounded best-k frontier or merge ordered streams; justify heap vs sort.

patterns.name: Backtracking decision trees
patterns.cue: Enumerate choices, prune invalid branches and undo local changes.

patterns.name: Graphs: traversal / components
patterns.cue: Adjacency or grid reachability; mark visited and cover disconnected components.

patterns.name: Graphs: unweighted / multi-source BFS
patterns.cue: Shortest unweighted distance or simultaneous spread from multiple sources.

patterns.name: Graphs: cycle / coloring
patterns.cue: Track parent/path or consistent coloring; visited alone is not enough.

patterns.name: Graphs: topological ordering
patterns.cue: Dependencies must precede dependents; detect cycles in a directed graph.

patterns.name: DP: 1D / take-skip
patterns.cue: Repeated state choices; define transition and base cases before storage.

patterns.name: DP: grid states
patterns.cue: Two coordinates determine the subproblem; obstacles change base transitions.

patterns.name: DP: subsequence transitions
patterns.cue: Ordered choices need state over an index or a pair of indices.

patterns.name: Greedy justified local choices
patterns.cue: Prove a local choice preserves a global solution; test counterexamples.

patterns.name: Intervals: merge / overlap / scheduling
patterns.cue: Ranges overlap or consume resources; clarify touching endpoints and ordering.

patterns.name: Sorting usage / comparators
patterns.cue: Order simplifies later work; compare values according to the actual objective.

patterns.name: High-value bit basics
patterns.cue: Pairs cancel under XOR or counting set bits; respect JS integer width.

patterns.name: Common numeric / matrix reasoning
patterns.cue: Carry propagation or in-place coordinate changes; clarify numeric limits.

patterns.name: Trie prefix lookup
patterns.cue: Exact words and shared prefixes must be distinguished.
